summary: Iter 76 — E2E test of 3 items on the shared backend + web + Expo web preview. === ITEM 2: Admin Revenue Snapshot (WEB) — PASS === Logged in as jenn@sailmorenow.com and opened /admin/analytics. The 'Revenue snapshot' card (data-testid=revenue-snapshot) renders directly under the top KPI grid with: • rev-mrr = $170.93 (matches backend GET /api/admin/revenue) • rev-arr = $2,051 • rev-active = 9 active paid subs • 6 per-tier breakdown rows (data-testid=rev-tier-*): boat_owner-premium ×1 $6.99/mo, boat_pro-basic ×1 $19.99/mo, boat_pro-featured ×1 $29.99/mo, boat_pro-premium ×2 $99.98/mo, partner-community_partner ×2 $0.00/mo, sailor-premium ×2 $13.98/mo — totals to $170.93/mo. Backend GET /api/admin/revenue with admin bearer returns the exact same numbers (mrr_total 170.93, arr_total 2051.16, active_paid 9, total_users 38). === ITEM 3: Profile picture congruent across web & mobile (object storage) === WEB — PASS: On /profile as jenn, clicking [data-testid=photo-upload-btn] fires the OS file picker, uploading a valid PNG shows the crop editor with [data-testid=crop-save]. Clicking crop-save uploads via multipart to POST /api/auth/avatar (200), toast 'Profile photo updated' appears, GET /api/auth/me returns picture='/api/files/sailmorenow/avatars/user_4b6b1bb144d4/b9b569f8ce2542799dc2a2e004e222e3.jpg' and 2 img tags on the page point at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + '/api/files/...'. MOBILE render — PASS: On the Expo web preview /profile, Jenn's avatar renders as an whose src is 'https://owsa-events-preview--7evdsk8f.preview.emergentagent.com/api/files/sailmorenow/avatars/user_4b6b1bb144d4/b9b569f8ce2542799dc2a2e004e222e3.jpg' — i.e. the mobile Avatar component (src/components/ui.tsx) correctly prepends EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to the relative /api/files/... path and shares the same image as web. Cross-platform congruence confirmed. MOBILE upload flow via Expo web preview — could NOT verify end-to-end from the browser preview: tapping [data-testid=change-avatar-btn] opens the file chooser, a valid PNG is selected, ImagePicker returns a data:URI asset, and the subsequent multipart POST to /api/auth/avatar returns 422. Root cause is the `new FormData(); fd.append('file', { uri, name, type })` pattern in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:106-107 — that shape is native-only; on React Native Web, FormData expects a real File/Blob, so the file part is serialized as '[object Object]' and FastAPI's UploadFile validator rejects it with 422. Backend curl-verified round-trip works, so this is a web-preview / RN-Web limitation of the upload code path — native iOS/Android builds should work. NOT a blocker; flagged as a mobile-web-preview parity gap. === ITEM 5: Crew Bank detail view — PASS on both surfaces === Seeded a second listing as pro.marina@sailmorenow.dev (premium) via POST /api/crew-bank/standalone so two cards exist (Jenn's own + Marina). WEB /crew-bank: • [data-testid=standalone-user_4b6b1bb144d4] (self card) and [data-testid=standalone-seed_marina] (other user) both render. • Clicking standalone-seed_marina opens [data-testid=crew-detail-modal] with [data-testid=crew-detail-seed_marina] containing Positions (Tactician, Trimmer), Experience (20 years pro sailing), Availability (Flexible), Notes (TEST_iter76), plus a Message button [data-testid=crew-detail-dm-seed_marina]. • Clicking standalone-user_4b6b1bb144d4 (own listing) opens the same modal WITHOUT the DM button (correctly hidden on own card). • Escape / close button closes the modal. • stopPropagation verified: clicking the inline [data-testid=dm-seed_marina] on the card navigates to /messages?to=seed_marina and does NOT open the detail modal. MOBILE /crew-bank (Expo web preview, 390×844): • [data-testid=crew-standalone-seed_marina] and [data-testid=crew-standalone-user_4b6b1bb144d4] render. • Tapping crew-standalone-seed_marina opens a bottom sheet with [data-testid=crew-detail-seed_marina] showing name (Salish Marina Services), market (Greater Seattle), Positions (Tactician, Trimmer), Experience (20 years pro sailing), Availability (Flexible), Notes (TEST_iter76), a 'Message Salish' button [data-testid=crew-detail-msg-seed_marina] and a Close button [data-testid=crew-detail-close]. Close button dismisses the sheet. Cleaned up the seed Marina listing after test (DELETE /api/crew-bank/standalone).

ui_bugs.issue: Multipart upload to /api/auth/avatar fails with HTTP 422 in the Expo web preview because `fd.append('file', { uri, name, type })` is a native-only RN pattern. On react-native-web the object serializes to the string '[object Object]', so FastAPI's UploadFile validator rejects it. Native iOS/Android builds should work (RN Fetch/FormData handles the {uri,name,type} shape natively). Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:106-113. Suggested fix: on web, first fetch(asset.uri) → blob() then fd.append('file', blob, name); or use Platform.OS==='web' branch. This affects testability in the Expo preview only.

parity_issues.issue: Web upload flow succeeds (multipart to /api/auth/avatar → 200, picture updated). Mobile-in-web-preview upload flow returns 422 because RN-Web FormData can't handle the {uri,name,type} object; must convert asset.uri → Blob first on web. Native mobile is expected to work (pattern is RN-canonical) but was not verified in this pass because the Expo preview is browser-based.

action_items: MEDIUM: In /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx `changeAvatar`, branch on Platform.OS. On web, fetch(asset.uri).then(r=>r.blob()) and fd.append('file', blob, name) so RN-Web produces a real multipart file part. Keep the native path as-is. Without this, the avatar-change flow is untestable in the Expo web preview and may also break on any future web-first mobile deployment.

GET /api/files/{path} returns 200 with proper Content-Type and Cache-Control: public,max-age=86400.

rca of the issue: Mobile Item 3 web-preview 422: `new FormData(); fd.append('file', { uri, name, type })` is a React Native native-only pattern that the RN networking layer intercepts and turns into a proper multipart file part. On the web (react-native-web) FormData is the browser's native FormData, which stringifies non-Blob/File values via String(), so the file part goes over the wire as the literal '[object Object]'. FastAPI's `UploadFile = File(...)` validator then rejects the field type with 422. Fix is a Platform.OS branch that first fetch()es the asset.uri (which on web is a Blob URL or data URI from expo-image-picker) into a Blob and appends the Blob as the file part.
